exposure: Prenatal diagnosis of congenital heart disease (CHD)
cohort: 6194 fetuses, including those prenatally diagnosed with CHD (n=170), non-cardiac anomalies (n=234), and no anomalies (n=5790)
finding: Prenatal diagnosis of CHD is associated with lower birth weight, preterm delivery, and increased risk of primary cesarean section.
mod_finding: Prenatal diagnosis of CHD is associated with an increased risk of primary cesarean section.
birth_weight: Neonates with CHD had significantly lower birth weights
